name: Adelphi University Continuing Education
description: Adelphi University non-credit course in social and ballroom dancing, held Friday evenings on the Garden City campus.
reviewNotes:
Added so Richard Fiore's class has an organizer; registration is online via the course page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Phone (516) 877-4260 is the course coordinator's office line in the School of Health Sciences as listed on the course page; the coordinator's personal staff email was not recorded. The social links are Adelphi University's main accounts (linked from the course page), not a dance-specific page. Address = main campus (One South Avenue); classes are in Woodruff Hall, Room 304. No logo saved: the site logo is an inline SVG sprite (not a downloadable image) and the touch icons are too small or a one-color mask. No photos of the dance class on the course page (its share image shows an unrelated person). Fall 2026 series ends Nov 20, 2026.

evidence.note: Course page 'Social and Ballroom Dancing' (non-credit workshop series): 11 Friday sessions Sept 11-Nov 20, 2026, 7:00-8:30 PM, Woodruff Hall Room 304; instructor Richard Fiore; $75 Adelphi community / $125 general; online registration;…
